ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import doMapping from modules::InvoiceMap output application/json --- if(!isEmpty(vars.currency)) doMapping(payload filter $.data.currency == lower(vars.currency)) else doMapping(payload)

%dw 2.0 import doMapping from modules::InvoiceMap output application/json var payloadjson = if (payload is Binary) read(payload, "application/json") else payload --- doMapping( {data: (payloadjson.data filter($.id == vars.invoiceId))} )[0]

%dw 2.0
output application/CSV separator=";", header=true
fun transformOperation(operation) = operation match { case "SUP"->"S" case "CRE"->"X" else -> operation } fun formatdatedebut(datedebut) = (datedebut as Date {format: "dd/MM/yyyy"} as String {format: "yyyyMMdd"}) ++ "000000J" fun formatdatefin(datefin) = (datefin as Date {format: "dd/MM/yyyy"} as String {format: "yyyyMMdd"}) ++ "235959J" fun nature(occupation) = occupation match { case "ACCT"->"Accident de travail" case "CLD"->"congé longue durée" case "LM"->"congé longue maladie" case "MO"->"congé maladie ordinaire" case "MP"->"Maladie professionnelle" case "CLM"->"congé longue maladie " case "?"->"accident de service" else -> occupation } fun typeOccupation(occupation) = occupation match { case "ACCT"->"M" case "CLD"->"M" case "LM"->"M" case "MO"->"M" case "MP"->"M" case "CLM"->"M" case "CLD"->"M" else -> occupation } --- payload map (item,index)-> { matricule: item.CODSEL, codeCentre: "", typeOcupation:typeOccupation(item.TEXTE_01), natureOccupation: nature(item.TEXTE_01), dateDebut: formatdatedebut(item.DATDEB), dateFin:formatdatefin(item.DATFIN), statut: "", poids: "", tempsTravail: "", tempsPresenceHeures: "", tempPresenceMinutes: "", idTypeCompteur: "", nbTitreRestaurant: "", commentaire: "", operation: transformOperation(item.LIG)
}
